reviews.author: Danny Kargar
reviews.text: We visited this Japanese restaurant on Saturday and, unfortunately, the service really let the experience down. The person who welcomed us when we arrived was very friendly and polite, which was a great first impression. However, the girl who took our order was quite rude and made us feel uncomfortable. The person who brought our food also had a very unpleasant attitude. What concerned us the most was the hygiene. While bringing food to our table, as well as serving other tables, the staff member repeatedly scratched himself. This was very off-putting and, in my opinion, is not appropriate when handling and serving food. The food itself was actually okay and we had no major complaints about the quality. However, when we visited on Saturday, we also wanted to order cocktails, but they didn't even have vodka available to make them, which was disappointing for a Saturday evening. Overall, the food was decent, but the service, attitude of some staff members, and especially the hygiene standards really need improvement. Unfortunately, these issues had a big impact on our overall experience.

reviews.author: Scott Lynch
reviews.text: Visited 26/09/26 Fantastic service - Manager and Barman looked after us very well - our table was in front of the bar. Very nice wine glasses. Amazing Chicken Green Curry Ramen! It's been on the menu since July 26' I understand and is a Thai-inspired green curry chicken broth with Sous vide chicken, pak choi, and a half soft-boiled egg with handcrafted noodles. I've been telling everyone how good it is! Everything was very clean. When you pay similar or more for a burger and chips in a restaurant, this is great value for money given the taste and quality. Looking forward to my next visit! For note - They hit the drum/gong on everyone's arrival - banging the large Taiko drum is a traditional way to welcome guests into the restaurant and create a lively, energetic atmosphere. In turn the staff shout “Irasshaimase!”, which is the traditional Japanese greeting meaning “welcome, come in". Learn something new everyday..

reviews.author: Moonfall Rosa
reviews.text: I recently visited on the 19th September, me and my partner had been looking forward to visiting after a wonderful visit to Manchester's last year, we booked a table ahead and arrived ten minutes ahead and were seated. However we were not impressed by the service sadly. Firstly as we were greeted the server seemed completely unenthusastic, sighing and banging the drum in passing which at that point why bother doing it if Ur not going to do it properly. I thought, fair enough, maybe they've had a bad night, a bad shift can really stink. However we were seated, it was all clean, that was no issue, but right away our server was hovering behind my partner waiting for us to pick what to have which made us feel rushed, would come to ask and we would say oh we've just sat down we haven't really had a chance to read the menu yet, mind you I'm not exaggerating, we sat down no more than 15 seconds ago. We then are looking through the menu and I kept glancing up to our waitress (a south Asian woman) because she was hovering and looking at us impatiently leaving us quite stressed as we tried to decide what to have. We chose drinks, they took a while to come out, but it wasn't terrible. Then eventually the food was ordered, the whole time the waitress was just silently hovering and glaring and felt quite intimidating, I don't really care about a waiter asking if we are ready to order yet since of course they have to ask, but we would be making a point of exaggerating we were reading and indecisive so she would relax and stop breathing down our necks but she wouldn't go, and asked us probably 5 times in the span of a couple minutes if we were ready. Eventually we ordered food (within about 10 minutes of being there) and then we waited almost an hour for the food to be ready, multiple tables who arrived after us and ordered after us got their food first, mind you they were also couples so 2 person tables and both also getting the same sort of order, two ramens. We were not apologised to for the wait and we tried to just let it go and enjoy the food because again peopl can just be having a bad day. However this experience has stayed with me and whole the food was delicious, I really can't help but think to the hour long wait for the food, the restaurant was not completely full, so I do not know if maybe an earlier rush had the staff/chefs exhausted or running low on certain stock. If this was the case I would love if in the future there could be a "this dish will take a bit longer to make, approx X amount of time" or even just to not have the waitress so persistent and in a foul mood the entire time. Even throughout the meal, she seemed to come over and just stand over us. Not asking us "how is your food?" (Which I genuinely prefer when that doesn't happen), but just standing and I'd keep glancing and she would just be glaring. I get people can have a bad day but it really ruined the dinner, I couldn't just have a nice experience and relax and enjoy the lovely food, I felt tense and on edge being watched the whole time. We had a service charge added on the bill which we didn't ask to be removed because we felt a bit intimidated and awkward but I certainly wouldn't have paid it given the choice. This should be a yes or no box to tick or press rather than automatically applying. The service didn't need to be exceptional above and beyond. Just not miserable, moody, glaring, intimidating.

reviews.author: Aliya Khan
reviews.text: If i could give a 0, I would. The service at maki and ramen Leeds by the tall south asian guy and the south asian woman is appalling. I came with a leg injury on my right knee, i requested a booth so I wouldnt be bumping and further injuring my leg due to the ridiculously small tables they provide for two people. They were very weird about giving away booth tables “in case someone else came” (even though the restaurant was mostly empty). They said we could only get a booth table if we booked in advance so we came another time with a booking. But they refused to give a table again. When we did manage to eat, the South Asian woman demanded I throw away my leftovers, even though we tidied up the table for them. What’s the point in paying service charge for such poor service?? The staff also seem to work in fear of the tyrannical stuck up south Asian guy. We were loyal customers but due to the circumstances given we won’t be returning to the leeds branch. The customer service ruins an otherwise beautiful restaurant.

reviews.author: Rashmi Patel
reviews.text: The place looks very nice. The was no atmosphere, a few people on both sides of us were moaning about the food .... Our instead of timing the food right between the starter and main there was about 5 to 10 mins between that. So we struggles to really enjoy the starters. And on a small table everything just felt jammed on. We had the pumpkin fritters type things and the gyoza which were nice the pumpkin thing was really nice and worth the money .. I had the seafood hellfire. That were the thought of something nice ended. The squid was tough and extremely chewy and felt horrible, the broth when I asked what meat is the broth made out of they told me they only use vegetable broth which was disappointing... The thin strips of grilled salmon was nice but due to how thin they were is was very crispy and hard. The prawns were NOT deveined. So I had a mouthful of grit and extras..... The noodle was not nice..... Overall the dish lacked proper flavour. My beautiful wife had a chicken yakisobi and she experienced a similar result. They automatically add a discretionary service charge. I don't mind actually paying for a good service but a normal standard service should be included. So again I was disappointed..... After a meal and starter each and 2 drinks we were £70+ light and disappointed.... Never will we return but on good news the post it's on the wall was great and I like the idea.

We explained it wasn’t and the food was remade but there was still fish flakes on the table after and we were left feeling distrustful and a bit sick. Neither of us could finish our food. When the waitress came to take our plates and ask if it was okay, we explained what had happened and said we weren’t happy, yet we were still charged full price for the meal. We won’t be coming here again and will be getting in touch with customer services.

I said to the waitress we’re going to leave and she said that she’s sorry but didn’t offer to try and make us stay. reviews.author: Deni Deni
reviews.text: I went with pearl. The food was super delicious and high quality. (Also many halal options) The drinks were so refreshing and pretty. I loved the atmosphere as it had great lighting and areas with sticky notes you could fill in yourself which was cute. There was also a projector showing the street of tokyo which i thought was really cool and added to the atmosphere again. I will definitely come back.Great dining experience underground. Small wait for table as went around lunch where it was busy.

reviews.author: david tapp
reviews.text: Stopped off alone for a quick bowl or noodles and enjoyed the service, but the food and downstairs seating could have been better. Nothing was particularly bad, but not the best. I had the black garlic tonkotsu, which had a nice broth (could have been thicker) but was lacking a little on the black garlic imo. The menma was good, the noodles were well cooked, but the chasui was not great, and I'm not sure why crispy onions were on the bowl. It was okay overall. I also had some chicken gyoza, which were tasty but slightly cold. The dipping sauce also just tasted like plain say sauce, which was a bit of a disappointment. Service was fast and friendly.

reviews.author: Jhon Martinez Mieres
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) We are very grateful for the exquisite flavor we just tasted, and RAJ's service was excellent. Thank you so much for everything, from Chile (Original) Muy agradecidos del exquisito sabor que acabamos de probar, y la atención de RAJ excelente, muchas gracias por todo, from Chile

reviews.author: Jovana Gajic
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) The staff are very good, very nice, friendly, and always there for the customers. Dish the best!!! (Original) sehr gut die Eingestellten sehr nett, freundlich und immer da für die Kunden. Dish the besttttt!!!

reviews.author: Vegan_Reviews
reviews.text: Wow, we did not expect this place to be so amazing! There are so many vegan options we didn’t know what to choose from! We thoroughly enjoyed the miso and hell ramen, not only was it delicious but the portions were massive! Very good value for the price. We will be back! We also loved the gong on arrival, although it did get a little annoying later in the night after being continuously hit.

reviews.author: ze yang
reviews.text: Love it! Highly recommend the Hell Ramen! And thanks to Amidu for the great service, he’s so kind and lovely:)

reviews.author: Emma G
reviews.text: The food was superb especially the pumpkin croquettes. The garlic ramen broth was unforgettable and we will be back for more

reviews.author: Yumeng Lai
reviews.text: this is my top restaurant in London, I really appreciate that. And Amidu gave us a really nice support and patience!

reviews.author: Angel
reviews.text: Excellent food and Amidu was great! :)

reviews.author: Alfred Adiguzel
reviews.text: Food was lovely, the atmosphere is great. Music playing, the decor and aesthetic very pretty. Lesley & Kaitlin were both very helpful. Definitely will return!

reviews.author: Afaf farah
reviews.text: Amazing food and very warm staff especially the lovely worker lexi she was a great help!

reviews.author: Anthony
reviews.text: K yaw and Navin were great. Came back to the store for Navin and was great to see both there smiles. Will be back for sure love the drums to the dragon to the food.

reviews.author: Tanjina Ali
reviews.text: Navin was great! He recommended the dragon roll (eel) and it was really good. He also helped us find halal options on the menu easily - thank you!

reviews.author: Sabiha
reviews.text: The food was delicious! Out host Navi was really helpful and attentive, and gave us the best recommendation for lunch. Will definitely be back again!

reviews.text: very friendly staff and good services, most hard working staffs I’ve encountered so far in London not gonna lie🤣

reviews.text: Great food and lovely stuff ! I absolutely loved the chicken gyoza and chicken laksa ❤️

reviews.author: Michael Angelo Amabuyok
reviews.text: Yuya A. was really helpful and very proactive towards the customers. What a lovely service. Amazing food and amazing atmosphere.

reviews.author: Mark Armatys
reviews.text: The Raman meal was delicious, nutritious and warmed the heart. Just what we needed after travelling around Uk for the past 2 weeks.

reviews.author: Moath Ashhab
reviews.text: Wonderful food amazing taste cheap price

reviews.author: Lyanna Gore
reviews.text: Food was lovely and came so fast, our server tinky was very polite and helpful!

reviews.author: Grace Spooner
reviews.text: Quick and great lunch deal

reviews.author: Hamzah Shah
reviews.text: We had such a brilliant experience making ramen! The whole experience was fun, enjoyable and really well organised, but what made it especially memorable was the amazing service from Chris. Chris was absolutely fantastic from start to finish. He was incredibly friendly, kind, welcoming and attentive, and he went out of his way to make sure we were comfortable and enjoying ourselves. Whenever we needed any help or guidance, he was there straight away with a smile and was more than happy to assist us. His customer service was genuinely outstanding. He was professional while still being very approachable and easy to talk to, and you could tell that he really cares about making sure customers have a great experience. Nothing felt like too much trouble for him. The ramen itself was delicious and we had such a lovely time making it, but Chris really made the whole experience even better. Staff like him are a credit to the business and deserve to be recognised for the effort they put in. Chris definitely deserves recognition for his excellent customer service and, in my opinion, would be a great candidate for further responsibility or promotion. We would happily come back again, especially knowing we would receive this level of service. Thank you Chris for making our visit such a memorable one! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Sadat Shaik
reviews.text: Too much time to get seated and to take order.

reviews.author: Wong Maggie
reviews.text: The onsen egg looks really weird and noodles aren’t springy enough. I go to Japan three times a year, and I’ve never had texture of that ramen noodles. Soup is fine.

reviews.author: Pari Talwar
reviews.text: The pumpkin croquettes were delicious as well as the spicy chicken teriyaki!!!!! Thank you so much to Diana for providing us with lovely service ♡

reviews.author: Richard Garner
reviews.text: Mediocre food, not awful but unsuitable prices for the quality I paid for a full pint but was only served half in a pint glass. I wouldn't return under current managment

reviews.author: Nina
reviews.text: Hells ramen was not spicy. So they charge for extra chilli sauce! They were half empty and we had ordered too much food for a table of 2 to fit properly. But they were too inflexible to move us. So the food was ok. Service could be better and if the spicy ramen isn't hot enough they shouldn't be charging for more chilli.

reviews.author: Hanan Abdalla
reviews.text: Our server ikran was amazing and so attentive. The food and atmosphere was great would recommend. Since it so central it so convenient.

reviews.author: Rosie Walsh
reviews.text: Norah and Nikki were both very attentive and really helpful throughout our meal. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Aisling Cunningham
reviews.text: Very good service. Staff very attentive

reviews.author: Hallie
reviews.text: Me and my friends were served by ikran who was so lovely and welcoming award her employee of the year plssss

reviews.author: Meech
reviews.text: Good atmosphere, great food, Hong looked after us and made us feel very welcome

reviews.author: joanna phillips
reviews.text: Great and welcoming service. Thank you Norah!

reviews.author: Natalie Chatterton
reviews.text: Delicious food, lots to choose from, but the resturant was soo crowded and loud, it was difficult to hear anyone talking.

reviews.author: Mohammed Rahman
reviews.text: First time visiting with my siblings, we brought in drinks from outside, as we didn’t see the sign on the outside saying no drinks from outside. We were told this by the staff which we understood, we put the drinks away after being told and didn’t bring them out after. However if you are going to impose this rule then at least bring out the water we requested when we ordered the meal. All our food came out but the water didn’t. Lacking in customer servicing when you were happy to tell us to put the drinks away but we’re not providing us water when asked during order taking. Nonetheless the food was good the sushi was nice and the beef ramen was good, the chicken however was bland. Looking at other reviews, I can see people had similar issues. Atmosphere is nice and calm, chill and the decor is beautiful, especially the post stick note wall.

reviews.author: Harry Barton (Yogogamers)
reviews.text: Tried this for the first time today after ages of trying to find really good ramen in Brum and was blown away. I had the tantan ramen which was super thick and creamy. Noodles were cooked well and the broth was fantastic. Staff were also super attentive and helpful, Charlotte W did a fantastic job as our server! Couldn't recommend this enough if you like Japanese food!

reviews.author: bi zhou
reviews.text: good environment and food, Hong S serve really well.

reviews.author: Liao Vicky
reviews.text: Had a really great experience here! The ramen was delicious and the service was excellent. Special thanks to Hong, who was incredibly friendly, attentive and helpful throughout our visit. Hong made us feel very welcome and really went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience.

reviews.author: Savhannah Deans
reviews.text: The food was amazing. The service for me was spot on - anything i asked for they straight up got me my items. The interior was way more than I expected, it was so fabulous and modern!

reviews.author: Steph
reviews.text: I visited for the 1st time last night the food and service was excellent from start to finish. Enjoyed the Cherry Blossom cocktail. Value for money was excellent.

reviews.author: Aish A
reviews.text: I visited with a friend and we both had the steak ramen (with the option to make it halal) and shared one servicing of Volcano rolls for starters. The ramen bowl had the best ramen broth I’ve ever tasted and it was incredibly filling! The steak was rich and sufficient and I cleared my bowl. I did notice the girls in the table beside us told that they couldn’t come in with outside food (they came in with their half drunk coffee/chai drinks from another shop). I thought that was a bit weird, but other than that the service was warm and relatively fast. I’ll definitely visit again when next I’m in Brum

reviews.author: Elizabeth Puddicombe
reviews.text: Had the best experience, I’ve wanted to come here for a little while and it didn’t disappoint, Navin was super helpful explaining the menu and service was so fast and genuinely so fresh and nice! Will be back!

reviews.author: Milz Beaumont
reviews.text: Amazing staff, really love their craft. Came and rolled sushi at our table, showed us the whole fish too! Our server Navin was so attentive

reviews.author: Natalia Almeida
reviews.text: Everything was so delicious! Loved the handrolls and sashimi. The sushi platter was sensational, genuinely no notes I was so obsessed. Deffo recommend going! I’d recommend the Akami Tuna Crudo, Tokyotini, Negi Toro Temaki, Omakase set and the new cocktail (Jada’s one! Shout out to her for amazing service)

reviews.author: GAMZE Oral
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) I ate the best sushi I've ever had there. The night before, they said there were no tables available, but maybe half an hour, so they let us try it as a complimentary item. The second night, when they saw us, our selection had been enriched, and we received the day's special as a gift. Above all, they were incredibly hospitable. They greeted each of us individually. I think I'll miss this place the most in London 😍 (Original) Hayatumda yediğim en güzel susshi yi orada yedim.Bir önceki gece yer yok ama belki yarım saat dediler bekleyip gittik diye hediye deneme yaptırdılar. İkinci gece bizi gördüklerinde ise yaptığımız seçim zenginleştirilmişti ve günün speciali bize hediye geldi. Herşey bir yana çok misafirperverdiler. Tek tek hoşgeldiniz dediler. Londra da en çok burayı özleyeceğim sanırın😍

reviews.author: Anastasia Volsko
reviews.text: Wandering before a show at Phoenix Theater and happened upon them. The smoke and age their own salmon and have some great hand rolls. The service was great.

reviews.author: nirvana Nirvana
reviews.text: It was my first time visiting Maki Nori, and the omakase experience was truly outstanding. I’ve had omakase in many places—including Japan—and I can easily say this was one of my absolute favorites! The food was exceptionally fresh and delicious, set inside a cozy restaurant with a vibrant atmosphere. A special mention to the General Manager Ginger, what a lovely person! He is incredibly knowledgeable about Japanese cuisine, highly professional, and so friendly. I highly recommend this spot and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Vincent Lao
reviews.text: First meal eating out after being away from London. Finally back to having one of my favourite Asian food, Japanese 🍣 We ordered their: - Chef's selection 15 pcs Omakase - 5 Hand Rolls Sets - Black Dragon (Eel) Roll - Snow Crab California Roll - Wagu Truffle Maki Roll - Chef's Ceviche - Prawn Tempera - Grilled Aubergene

reviews.author: Payton Godlewski
reviews.text: I had such an amazing time here! The sushi is super high-quality and fairly affordable as well. One of the sushi chefs, Victoria, took the time to tell us all about where they sourced the fish and chat about her experience as a sushi chef! Couldn’t recommend this place more! Best sushi in London!!

reviews.author: Huw Siddle
reviews.text: The food was delicious and very interesting - the Tokusei menu was simple but very tasty, and the crudo and roll menus provided some interesting more out-there options, but the service was the highlight by far. Victoria specifically took the time out of her prep to answer a lot of our questions about the dishes and where they come from, which was absolutely above and beyond!

reviews.author: Arianna Leardini
reviews.text: What a surprise, this little restaurant has some really fantastic dishes. The “Crudo” are my favourites but the fried chicken too. Staff very professional and friendly, first time I tried Sake and the Jinger guy has great recommendations.

reviews.author: Olimpia Bernasconi
reviews.text: Impressive venue, very minimal but stylish!! The food is spectacular and tasty, the service refined and caring! The guy with the big moustaches definitely knows the menu, and can definitely give you some good advices. Great sake selection too!!! I will be back for more!!!

reviews.author: wing in lee
reviews.text: The chef is amazing, all the ingredients are very fresh
